headline: Paraguay Faces Political Crisis Over Ueno Bank Intervention
summary: Opposition lawmakers are pushing to impeach President Santiago Peña following the intervention of Ueno Bank, which left nearly three million customers without access to their funds.
why: Banking sector instability and subsequent political unrest can significantly impact sovereign risk and foreign investment sentiment in emerging markets.

impacts.name: Paraguay
impacts.why: Political instability and banking crises typically increase sovereign risk and currency volatility.
